It continuously scans multi-cloud, SaaS/PaaS, and IaC environments to detect waste, prevent inefficiencies, auto-identify resource owners, and accelerate remediation with IaC fixes and shift-left policies. Adaptive6 is an AWS Partner Network and a FinOps Foundation Premier Member, integrating with enterprises' ecosystems to deliver trusted, scalable cost governance. View as: Our Philosophy Adaptive6 is the first Cloud + AI Cost Governance & Optimization platform built to eliminate hidden cloud waste, automate and accelerate the remediation process, and propose code fixes - all while embedding security into every action. Beyond surface-level cost issues, we uncover Shadow Waste across Cloud, PaaS, and Code - empowering enterprises to act before costs escalate. From day one, Adaptive6 was engineered to the highest standards: full encryption, continuous monitoring, role-based access control (RBAC), SSO/SAML integration, and strict alignment with SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, and leading cloud security best practices. Security and compliance aren’t features - they’re the foundation. We continually evolve our 400+ waste detections, AI-driven remediation workflows, and pre-deployment guardrails to ensure enterprises can optimize faster, prevent issues before they happen, and operate with complete confidence. jobs.title: Senior Backend Developer
jobs.description: DESCRIPTION Adaptive6 is the leading Cloud and AI Cost Governance platform. From complex cloud architectures to modern AI workloads and AI agents, we empower engineering and FinOps teams to take full control of their enterprise spend. We don’t just report numbers - we provide actionable intelligence and continuous cost optimization that directly impacts the bottom line. Trusted by industry giants like Ticketmaster and Bayer (who achieved a 20x ROI), our customers consistently see massive value within days. Backed by top-tier investors, Adaptive6 has raised $44M in total funding to support our aggressive global expansion. We are scaling rapidly, and we’re looking for the next backend developer to join our team! In this position you will help architect and develop core backend components that power our Cloud Cost Governance platform, from early product concepts to production-ready features. Take full ownership of product requirements end-to-end — including design, development, testing, and delivery of features. Work closely with engineering teammates, product managers, and solutions engineers to deliver robust, scalable capabilities and tackle deep technical problems. Research, experiment with, and build innovative solutions to detect and remediate cloud inefficiencies, making cloud usage smarter and leaner. Combine a strategic view of system design with a hands-on ability to dive deep into technical details and fine-tune performance. Engage directly with enterprise customers to understand their evolving cloud cost challenges, gather feedback, and help shape product direction based on real-world needs. REQUIREMENTS 7+ years of backend engineering experience with modern programming languages (e.g., Go, Python). Strategic thinker who can deconstruct complex problems and deliver pragmatic, scalable solutions. Solid track record designing and implementing distributed systems using microservices and cloud-native patterns. Background with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP). Background in building large-scale B2B SaaS systems on public cloud infrastructure. Self-driven, curious, and takes initiative.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.description: DESCRIPTION Adaptive6 is the leading Cloud and AI Cost Governance platform. From complex cloud architectures to modern AI workloads and AI agents, we empower engineering and FinOps teams to take full control of their enterprise spend. We don’t just report numbers - we provide actionable intelligence and continuous cost optimization that directly impacts the bottom line. Trusted by industry giants like Ticketmaster and Bayer (who achieved a 20x ROI), our customers consistently see massive value within days. Backed by top-tier investors, Adaptive6 has raised $44M in total funding to support our aggressive global expansion. We are scaling rapidly, and we’re looking for high-performing sales leaders to join our Go-To-Market team. We're hiring an Enterprise Account Executive to own net-new logo acquisition at the top of the market. This is a hunter role: self-sourced pipeline, competitive multi-stakeholder sales cycles, and six- and seven-figure outcomes. It is not a farmer role, not an inbound-fed closer seat, and not a technical demo seat. You will sell top-down to economic buyers — CTOs, CISOs, VPs of Cloud/Infrastructure, and VPs of Engineering — building urgency and budget priority in a category many organizations haven't fully budgeted for yet. The strongest candidates will have proven this exact motion before: creating a business case from a technical problem, expanding a deal beyond its original scope, and winning against multiple credible competitors rather than closing on brand or inbound demand alone. ﻿What you'll do: Own the full sales cycle for net-new enterprise accounts — from self-sourced prospecting through negotiation and close. Build and sustain executive-level relationships, mapping organizations and multi-threading across buying committees. Conduct deep discovery to uncover cloud cost drivers and governance gaps, translating them into business-value cases for C-level buyers. Negotiate and close six- and seven-figure contracts in competitive, multi-stakeholder deals. Partner cross-functionally with Sales Engineering, Product, and Customer Success to run technically credible, value-led cycles. Consistently meet or exceed quarterly bookings and pipeline generation targets. REQUIREMENTS 7+ years of full-cycle enterprise SaaS sales experience with a pure "Hunter" mindset focused on net-new logo acquisition. 3+ years selling into Cybersecurity, Cloud Infrastructure, CSPM, DevOps, or FinOps personas. Proven track record of hitting quota and closing six- and seven-figure contracts ($150K+ ACV). Demonstrated experience in Top-Down selling to C-level buyers (CTOs, CISOs, VPs of Cloud/Infra). Conversant in cloud infrastructure concepts (AWS/Azure/GCP, FinOps, K8s, Savings Plans) without relying solely on an SE. Strong grounding in enterprise sales methodologies, with a proven ability to create urgency, reframe buyer thinking, and multi-thread complex deals.
